# Surfaces UI

> React components for data and analytics that agents can compose: tables that push sorting, filtering and paging into SQL, charts that follow Tufte and Few, pivots, SQL editing, catalog and schema browsing, data modelling, chat, forms and pages. Agents describe UI as A2UI v0.9 JSON against one catalog; the client validates and draws it with its own components. Contracts are protobuf (proto/surfaces/v1).

## For agents drawing UI
- [Agent prompt](docs/catalog/agent-prompt.md): the message format, every component and its props, as a system prompt
- [Catalog as JSON Schema](docs/catalog/catalog.json): component props, and each event's payload under `x-events`
- [Human-in-the-loop patterns](docs/catalog/patterns.md): complete surfaces for decisions a person must make
- [Site catalog](docs/catalog/site/README.md): for pages people read (landing pages, docs, posts): the basic components plus Hero, Section, FeatureGrid, DeviceFrame, PromptReveal, Showcase, NavBar, Footer, Media, Quote, Callout, PostCard and PostList, with its own prompt and JSON Schema
- [Agent integration](docs/agent-integration.md): the turn loop, response contracts (`expects`), what comes back each turn, adapters (Claude, OpenAI-compatible, Loom, your own), `surfaceAgentPrompt` and `dataTools`, choosing the model from a page (`ModelService`), approvals that pause a turn, keeping a thread across reloads

## For people integrating
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): `npx create-surfaces`, install, providers, data sources, theming, chat, delivery
- [Packages](docs/packages.md): every published package, grouped by what an app installs, what each brings with it, and its peers
- [Recipes](docs/recipes/README.md): tested code for common jobs: chat with Claude over your data, a cross-filtered dashboard, your own backend, Postgres/Teradata/S3, Next.js (a data view in a page, or a site's pages as routes with static export), Claude Desktop (MCP), an approval before SQL runs, a form that writes back, a dashboard a person can arrange, records a person manages (a table of accounts, changed one at a time or all that match)
- [Component reference](docs/catalog/components): one page per catalog component (what an agent draws), each example as JSX markup (`analyticsMarkup`), A2UI and a json-render spec
- [App components](docs/components/README.md): one page per component an app places itself (AnalyticsChat, Chat, PageStudio, ThemePicker, ConnectionBuilder, ModelLineage, ChecksPanel, ObjectInfo, CertificationBadge, ItemControls, ResizeHandle, SegmentedControl, DataTable, SelectionBar, Pagination, ConfirmDialog, StatusBadge, Combobox, Popover, NavBar, SurfacesDevTools): plain props, the parts a host supplies in code, callbacks, an example
- [Styling](docs/styling.md): themes, scoped themes, `--sf-*` variables, `className`, `styles.css` or `styles.layer.css` (`@layer surfaces`); `.sf-*` classes are internal
- [Accessibility](docs/accessibility.md): WCAG 2.2 AA mapping and keyboard keys

## Contracts
- [agent.proto](proto/surfaces/v1/agent.proto): SendRequest, SendResponse, SurfaceState, ResponseContract, SurfaceErrorInput, ApprovalRequest, ApprovalAnswer
- [query.proto](proto/surfaces/v1/query.proto) and [catalog.proto](proto/surfaces/v1/catalog.proto): ViewQuery, results, tables, columns, keys
- [view.proto](proto/surfaces/v1/view.proto) and [forms.proto](proto/surfaces/v1/forms.proto): saved surfaces, forms
- [models.proto](proto/surfaces/v1/models.proto): ModelService, which model each agent backend runs (no keys)
- [semantic.proto](proto/surfaces/v1/semantic.proto): SemanticService, SemanticModel (a query with dimensions, measures and metrics, versioned)

## For working in this repository
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the rules, commands, and where each package's and component's own notes are
- [docs/status.md](docs/status.md): what is built and what has run against real systems

- `AnalyticsChat` (`@surfaces-ui/chat`): a chat for data people with optional saved conversations (`SessionList`, `librarySessions`), file and table attachments, a Model menu (grouped by provider when the host passes `providers`, every model in the Agent setup panel) and one Agent setup menu holding the agent, its skills and its connectors (from `DescribeAgents`), voice (`SpeechAdapter`, `browserSpeech`) and an arrow-up Send; small lists are composer menus, big lists are panels on a right rail.
- `FileBrowser` (`@surfaces-ui/components`): folders and files in a source's storage (`DataSource.listFiles`, optional) and folders opened from the person's computer; names only, handed to a chat as `DataRef`s of kind `file`.

- `Explorer` (`@surfaces-ui/components`): fields as generated pills (attributes, metrics, derived metrics) on shelves, all plain JSON an agent can set; derived metrics are `ViewQuery.derived`, worked out by the engine. `ExploreState.chart` says how it is drawn: bars, line or area, `swap` for bars on their side, and per measure a kind and a right-hand scale; pills move along a shelf by drag (touch included) or Alt+arrows.
- Page-wide filters: a data component's `filters` may be `{ "@path": … }`; a `FilterBar` writes the shared list and a `Chart` with `select` filters on click.
- `ReportBuilder` (`@surfaces-ui/components`): the dashboard pattern as one plain-JSON document: pills once, filters once, tiles (shelves) many; an agent writes `fields` and `tiles`.
- Semantic models (`@surfaces-ui/data` `Semantics`, `memorySemantics`; `connectSemantics`; components `SemanticsProvider`, `SemanticModelEditor`): dimensions, measures and metrics defined once over a query. `Explorer` and `ReportBuilder` take `model` and draw its pills; a pill is added to the model with "Add to the model" (key M). A model states its grain and key (checked by the engine before a new one is kept), and its rows are a written query or tables and joins, drawn as a `ModelDiagram` with `rowsFrom` (the first table is where the rows come from; each join has a kind, `type`: inner, left, right or full, and says whether it can repeat rows). The query from tables names every column when two share a name, so it runs on any engine. An agent reads models with `list_semantic_models` / `describe_semantic_model` and proposes a new model (`create`) or a change as a `SemanticModelEditor` with `proposed` (`add`, `remove`, `rows`); the person edits the joins, grain, key and fields, and only they save. Patterns: `create-a-semantic-model`, `change-a-semantic-model`. A model can be built on a pipeline dataset (`SemanticModel.dataset`, `semanticModelFromDataset`, `proposed.rows.dataset`): its grain and key are the dataset's, checked by the pipeline after every build, and `ModelLineage` shows when it was built, its latest checks and what it reads, over every explorer and report on the model.
- `SurfacesText` (`@surfaces-ui/components`; or `setLocale`, `setLabels`, `resetLabels`, `label`, `numberFormat`, `defaultLabels`): the page's locale for every number and date, and replacement words for the data components (grid, result, chart, pivot, filters, form, plan review, receipt, report), by typed label name. One locale per page. See "Words and numbers" in docs/getting-started.md.
- `ItemControls` + `standardControls` (`@surfaces-ui/components`): the one set of icon controls (change, view, wider, narrower, move, duplicate, remove) for any item; hover or focus shows them, and `CONTROLS_QUIET` keeps two layers from showing at once.
- `ResizeHandle` (`@surfaces-ui/components`): a handle on the right or bottom edge of a positioned parent that sizes a width or height (`edge`, `value`, `min`, `max`, `snap`, `step`, `unitPixels`, `startFrom`, `onChange`, `onChangeEnd`, `onReset`, `label`, `valueText`, `always`); a `separator` dragged with pointer events (mouse, touch, pen), arrows, Home, End, Enter or double click to reset. The plain maths: `clampResize`, `dragResize`, `keyResize`. Arrange draws the same handle, and `useArrange({ resizeWhileViewing: true })` keeps the size handles while nobody is arranging (`arrange.surfaceFrame`).
- `SegmentedControl` (`@surfaces-ui/components`): two to eight equal choices as one bar with a sliding thumb; a radio group (`label`, `options`, `value`, `onChange`, `fit`).
- `DataTable` + `SelectionBar` + `Pagination` (`@surfaces-ui/components`): the rows an app holds from its own server (people, invitations, jobs). The table sorts, filters and pages nothing: `onSortChange` and `Pagination`'s `onChange` ask the host for another page. Check boxes (`selected`, `onSelectedChange`, `selectable`), each row's `ItemControls` (`rowControls`) and menu (`rowMenu`); `SelectionBar` holds the actions and offers "Select all N that match" (`allMatching`), after which the host acts on its search, not on keys. For a query's rows use `DataGrid`.
- `ConfirmDialog` / `useConfirm` (`@surfaces-ui/components`): a modal `<dialog>` asking before an action that is hard to undo; `await confirm({ title, body, confirmLabel, danger })` is true or false. Report the outcome with `ActionReceipt`.
- `StatusBadge` (`@surfaces-ui/components`): a short status in words, backed by a tone's colour and shape (`label`, `tone`, `description`).
- `Combobox` (`@surfaces-ui/components`): a text box with suggestions the host searches for (`label`, `value`, `onChange`, `options`, `onPick`, `loading`); the ARIA 1.2 combobox.
- `Popover` (`@surfaces-ui/components`): a button that opens a small panel of controls beneath it, kept inside the window (`label`, `summary`, `children`, `align`, `open`, `onOpenChange`); a non-modal dialog from a disclosure button, Escape gives focus back to the button.
- Pipelines (`@surfaces-ui/data` `Pipelines`, `memoryPipelines`, `pipelineDigest`; `connectPipelines`; reference runner `@surfaces-ui/pipelines`; components `PipelinesProvider`, `PipelineView`, `DatasetReview`, `ChecksPanel`, `PipelineGraph`): datasets built from a source's tables by read-only queries, each with what it reads, its grain, key, columns, row rules and checks over the built table (unique, not_null, relationships, accepted_values, row_count; a key adds unique and not-null). A pipeline runs only definitions from config or ones a person approved: `savePipeline` takes the draft, the version it was based on, the approver and the digest of what they saw. Agents get `pipelineTools` (`list_pipelines`, `describe_pipeline`, `check_pipeline`, `run_pipeline` behind an approval, `get_run`, `propose_dataset`, which saves nothing and is drawn as a `DatasetReview`); MCP registers the same tools, plus `show_pipeline` and a `propose_dataset` that draws the `DatasetReview` itself, filled in by the server. Headless: `surfaces-pipelines run <id> [--select +name] [--json]`, exit 1 on a failed build or check. Pattern: `review-a-transformation`. dbt projects (`@surfaces-ui/pipelines-dbt`: `dbtPipelines({ sourceId, read: targetDir(dir), invoke?: dbtCommand({ projectDir }) })`, `semanticModelsFromDbt`): read from dbt's artifacts (manifest, run_results, sources, catalog, semantic_manifest) as a `Pipelines` backend; dbt alone builds, compiled SQL is a read-only preview, a run asks dbt to build only behind a person's approval, and nothing is saved; `combinePipelines` puts several backends behind one.
- Dev tools (`@surfaces-ui/devtools` `SurfacesDevTools`; `@surfaces-ui/trace` `createRecorder`, `traceDataSource`, `traceAgent`, `traceService`, `recordMessage`, `replay`, `diffJson`, `performanceTracks`; `@surfaces-ui/trace/react` `TraceProvider`, `useRecorder`): wrap the app once in `<SurfacesDevTools>` and the library's providers and hooks record themselves: messages in (raw, upgraded, catalog issues), components drawn, problems, state, events out, agent turns, service calls with SQL and timings. A button and Ctrl+Shift+D open a docked panel with time travel (any surface redrawn read-only as it stood at a step; its data is queried live). On in development, absent in production unless `enabled`. A trace never holds row values or credentials. See "Dev tools" in docs/getting-started.md.
